chunks: As for the one who said that there is no Imam after Hasan (peace be upon him), his statement is invalid due to what we have proven regarding the fact that time is never devoid of a proof of God, rationally and legally. And as for the one who said that Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) died and will live after his death, his statement is invalid by the same reasoning, because it leads to the creation being devoid of an Imam from the time of his death until Allah brings him back to life.

key_terms.أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ: Abu Muhammad, referring to Imam al-Hasan al-Askari (a.s.)
key_terms.إِمَام: Imam, the divinely appointed leader and proof of God
key_terms.حُجَّة: Proof, a title for the Imam who serves as God's argument for humanity
key_terms.خُلُوِّ الْخَلْقِ: The state of the creation being devoid/empty

ai.seo_question: What is the rational and legal proof that time is never devoid of an Imam?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi grounds his refutation in the principle of *Istidlal al-Aql wa al-Shar'* (rational and scriptural proof), asserting that the Earth can never be devoid of a *Hujjah* (Proof of God). He specifically targets the 'Gap of Imamate' (*Fatra*) theory, arguing that if Abu Muhammad (al-Mahdi) were to die and remain in the grave until resurrection, the creation would suffer a period without an Imam, which contradicts the necessity of divine guidance. This establishes the Imam's continuous presence, whether in occultation or visible, as a theological imperative for cosmic order.
